titulo: Polyamine Treatment in Elderly Patients With Coronary Artery Disease

braco.texto: Spermidine will be given orally as capsules of cellulose with spermidine (24 mg/day) and rice flour.
braco.textoPt: A espermidina será administrada por via oral em cápsulas de celulose com espermidina (24 mg/dia) e farinha de arroz.
